answer: Assign every identity to a random pseudonym party each cycle: a simultaneous local gathering of about 20 strangers who cross-check each other's presence in person, each party issuing one single-use copper credential per participant. A bridge of fakes collapses here, because one operator cannot sit in two parties at once: running 100 fakes needs 100 bodies at 100 parties in the same hour, while one honest person attends one party near their knoll and keeps full weight. A credential reused or sold is void, and its holder loses its bond plus 10 epochs of rewards.
